title: SEC 13F Whale Tracker Input
description: Pulls each fund manager's latest 13F-HR holdings from EDGAR and diffs them against the prior quarter, returning new positions, adds, trims, exits, and unchanged holdings with value and portfolio weight.

managers.title: Fund managers
managers.description: Institutional managers to track, each a fund name or an SEC CIK number. Names are resolved to a CIK via EDGAR full text search over 13F filers, e.g. ["Berkshire Hathaway", "Scion Asset Management", "1336528"].

maxManagers.title: Max managers
maxManagers.description: Cap on how many managers to process from the list above.

minPositionValueUsd.title: Minimum position value (USD)
minPositionValueUsd.description: Drop holdings worth less than this. 0 keeps every position. Useful to focus on a manager's meaningful bets.

materialChangePct.title: Material change threshold (percent)
materialChangePct.description: A share count change smaller than this percent is labeled unchanged rather than increased or reduced. 10 means a position must move at least 10 percent to count as an add or trim.

includeUnchanged.title: Include unchanged holdings
includeUnchanged.description: Keep positions that did not change materially. Turn off to return only new positions, adds, trims, and exits.

maxHoldingsPerManager.title: Max holdings per manager
maxHoldingsPerManager.description: Cap on rows returned per manager, applied to current holdings plus exits.

userAgent.title: User-Agent (optional)
userAgent.description: SEC requires a descriptive User-Agent with a contact email. Provide your own, e.g. "Acme Research you@acme.com". A default is used if blank.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. EDGAR is a public API that does not need a proxy, so the default is no proxy.
